steps.say: Methotrexate monitoring is starting with baseline blood counts, creatinine, and liver enzymes. Complete blood count with serum creatinine, AST, and ALT is setting the baseline. Rechecks every 2 to 4 weeks during escalation and every 8 to 12 weeks in maintenance are following the start. Transaminases beyond 2 to 3 times normal are shelving the drug. Counts with kidneys and liver are setting the rhythm.

steps.say: Hydroxychloroquine retinopathy screening is following 2016 eye academy rules. Baseline fundus examination with SD-OCT inside the first year is starting the watch. Annual 10-2 visual fields with SD-OCT after 5 years are continuing it. Daily doses above 5.0 mg per kg or renal impairment are pulling screening earlier. Baseline scans with yearly fields are guarding sight.

steps.say: JAK inhibitors are carrying boxed warnings from ORAL Surveillance. Tofacitinib with baricitinib and upadacitinib is sharing the risk. Major cardiovascular events with venous clots in legs and lungs are striking the treated. Serious infections with lymphoma and lung cancers are completing the quartet. Boxed warnings are bundling clots with cancers.

steps.say: IL-6 receptor blockers are fattening lipids while dipping neutrophils. Tocilizumab with sarilumab is raising total cholesterol, LDL, and triglycerides dose-dependently. Acute abdominal pain is demanding instant evaluation.

steps.say: Anti-TNF agents are strictly forbidden in failing hearts. Moderate-to-severe failure of class 3 or 4 is barring the drug. Ejection fraction below 50 percent is barring it equally. Extra heart failure admissions with cardiovascular deaths in trials are justifying the ban. Failing pumps are forbidding anti-TNF.

steps.say: Calcineurin blockers are steered by blood levels and kidney watches. Tacrolimus with cyclosporine is dosed to 12-hour trough targets. Troughs with creatinine are steering narrow drugs.
